This template is to be used for citing individual videos on the official [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] [https://www.youtube.com/c/Disney YouTube channel].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{DisneyYouTube|video=|text=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the Youtube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{DisneyYouTube|url=ZjxLBUhEIHI|text=Star Wars Forces of Destiny &#124; Porg Problems &#124; Disney|date=2018-03-19|archivedate=20200405124812}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DisneyYouTube|url=ZjxLBUhEIHI|text=Star Wars Forces of Destiny &#124; Porg Problems &#124; Disney|date=2018-03-19|archivedate=20200405124812}}
